blurb: Explore the wild side of the Outer Banks with Coastal Explorations. Our guided 4x4 wild horse tours take you deep into the 4WD-only beaches north of Corolla, from Corolla to Carova, in search of the legendary Corolla wild horses - descendants of the Spanish Mustangs that have roamed these dunes for over 400 years.
